notes.title: Fenimore Fillmore: The Westerner, support now ultra wide screens
notes.content:
We've released the version 1.8.0 that support ultra wide screens and also we've fixed all the issues with the aspect ratio.
Enjoy :lunar2019coolpig:

notes.title: For those the game crash randomly. We've removed the mp3 system to play the audios.
notes.content:
We are using ogg for the audios right now and the game is more stable, because with the mp3 there was an issue in few of you with the codecs.
Enjoy:lunar2019coolpig:

notes.title: Fenimore Fillmore: The Westerner, extra high quality textures
notes.content:
We updated the textures to go even further with extra high quality.
Also for those want to play in 4:3 on video settings turn on the option "Show all video modes", and then select a video mode support 4:3 and that's it.:lunar2019coolpig:
